component.name: SofaLink
component.summary: PS4 Remote Play with a controller-focused SteamOS setup

description.p: SofaLink is a custom fork of chiaki-ng with a PS4-focused home screen, live controller detection and an integrated DualShock 4 setup guide.
Remote Play, console registration, video, audio and controller handling are provided by the chiaki-ng engine. This is an independent personal build, not an official Sony or chiaki-ng release.
